Question ID: ANP_U01_L06_GP_Q01
MLA Standard: MLA.ANP.ORG.03

Guided practice item 1.
Lesson focus: Enzymes and Physiological Conditions
Stimulus: Enzyme graph/data

A student is reviewing the required visual and must explain the first visible structure-function connection. Which answer uses the lesson evidence most accurately?

generalfeedback.text: Teachable feedback: First, identify enzyme, substrate, and active site. Then use the required stimulus (Enzyme graph/data) to connect the visible evidence to enzyme function under physiological conditions. Correct reasoning stays inside MLA.ANP.ORG.03 and avoids the common mistake: thinking high temperature or extreme pH always improves enzyme activity.
